dz: 瑞典和俄国沙皇多国签订"斯托尔博沃条约",结束了印加战争并关闭了俄国出波罗的海.
de: Sweden and the Tsardom of Russia sign the Treaty of Stolbovo, ending the Ingrian War and shutting Russia out of the Baltic Sea.

t: 亨利四世被加冕为法国国王.
te: Henry IV is crowned King of France.
dz: 亨利四世被加冕为法国国王.
de: Henry IV is crowned King of France.

te: The Treaty of Berwick is signed by England and the Lords of the Congregation of Scotland, establishing the terms under …
dz: "伯威克条约"由英格兰和苏格兰圣公会的领主签署,规定了允许英国武装部队在苏格兰驱逐占领法国军队的条件.
de: The Treaty of Berwick is signed by England and the Lords of the Congregation of Scotland, establishing the terms under which English armed forces were to be permitted in Scotland in order to expel occupying French troops.

te: Abaoji, chieftain of the Yila tribe, is named khagan of the Khitans.
dz: 阿保机，伊拉部落酋长，被封为契丹可汗。
de: Abaoji, chieftain of the Yila tribe, is named khagan of the Khitans.

t: 君士坦丁堡大学由皇帝特奥多修斯二世在妻子艾莉亚·尤多西亚的敦促下所建立.
te: The University of Constantinople is founded by Emperor Theodosius II at the urging of his wife Aelia Eudocia.
dz: 君士坦丁堡大学由皇帝特奥多修斯二世在妻子艾莉亚·尤多西亚的敦促下所建立.
de: The University of Constantinople is founded by Emperor Theodosius II at the urging of his wife Aelia Eudocia.

dz: 特萨洛尼察的教谕:特奥多修斯一世皇帝和他的同治皇帝格拉蒂安和瓦伦丁二世宣布他们希望所有罗马公民皈依尼斯涅基督教.
de: Edict of Thessalonica: Emperor Theodosius I and his co-emperors Gratian and Valentinian II declare their wish that all Roman citizens convert to Nicene Christianity.
